cornerRadius.$description: Corner rounding roles. Pick by the size and prominence of the element; rounding grows with the element.

full.$description: Pill and circle shapes that stay fully round at any size: chips, tags, badges, avatars.

large.$description: Large controls and prominent containers: cards, toasts, sheets, hero-sized controls.

medium.$description: Standard controls and grouped containers: buttons, inputs, search fields, inset sections.

small.$description: Compact elements: small controls, tooltips, inline hints.
